title: Conclusion

internal_section_headings.heading: (unnamed opening — recapitulative vignette of learning a new game)
internal_section_headings.note: Spans book pp.181-182. Confirmed at fulltext line 6291 ('Conclusion' chapter title) through line 6346. Opens with a second-person experiential recap of the first few hours of learning a new game (mechanics, exploration, narrative delivery, multiplayer communication) — mirrors the Intro's autobiographical-experiential register. Closes with the 'suspension of disbelief' diagnosis (lines 6309-6318) and the cybernetic-looping-of-simulation-and-imagination thesis (lines 6323-6346) that recasts belief as incorporation rather than suspension.

internal_section_headings.heading: Implications
internal_section_headings.note: Confirmed at fulltext line 6347. Spans book pp.182-184. Three substantive moves: (a) the volume's tripartite media-object/player/sociocultural-context reframing displaces typical binaries (game/nongame, work/play, real/virtual) — lines 6348-6357; (b) immersion + presence are critiqued as 'here/there' dichotomies, with incorporation reframed as coextensive-with-physical-being — lines 6362-6376; (c) METHODOLOGICAL REFLECTION via the Genette analogy (lines 6393-6415) + the structural-modelling-as-formalism / poststructural-successor framing (lines 6416-6430). The Genette analogy is the chapter's load-bearing reflexive move.

internal_section_headings.heading: Imagining Worlds into Being
internal_section_headings.note: Confirmed at fulltext line 6431. Spans book pp.184-185. Forward-looking peroration: collective design-team-and-player co-production of game experience (lines 6432-6437); cultural-historical arc from spoken-word imagined worlds → print → mechanical moving-image → networked digital simulation (lines 6445-6453); incorporation as 'increasingly sought-after experience' across designers/consumers/technologists (lines 6457-6465). Book p.186 blank.

expected_interlocutors.name: Gérard Genette
expected_interlocutors.depth_of_treatment: load-bearing analogical anchor (sole named interlocutor in the chapter)
expected_interlocutors.engagement_note: Genette is invoked as a model-revision exemplar: his analysis of narrative time in Proust's À la recherche du temps perdu 'required a revision and a response to criticism', published as Narrative Discourse Revisited. Calleja explicitly disclaims that his own volume necessitates immediate revision but uses the Genette case to license the structural-modelling-then-poststructural-revision arc as the canonical trajectory for any incisive analytic model. The structural / poststructural distinction is treated as a literary-theory precedent that legitimates PIM as 'a first considered step' (line 6426) toward 'more evolved and sensitive modeling' (line 6428). Manifest cite_check confirms Genette is cited in the Conclusion (lines 6394, 6403) in addition to his Ch.7 appearance.

UNIQUE TO THIS UNIT. The Genette analogy (book pp.183-184, fulltext lines 6393-6415) is the volume's ONLY exegetical engagement with literary-theory-as-model-revision exemplar. Phase 2 must capture this as a within-text exegetical edge cluster: (a) Narrative Discourse (1980) cited; (b) Narrative Discourse Revisited (1988) cited as model-revision case; (c) Proust À la recherche du temps perdu cited as the structuralist analytic target; (d) structuralism → poststructuralism arc invoked as canonical successor trajectory. Note: Calleja's Ch.7 Narrative Involvement also engages Genette (per manifest IG-07 internal_section_headings) — capture the Genette-thread as a longitudinal exegetical motif spanning IG-07 (focalization, narrative time) and IG-11 (model-revision). This is the closest Calleja comes to a 'theoretical lineage' self-identification.

phase2_special_guidance: LIGHTER CHAPTER — 6 pages, ≥20 edges target. REQUIRED elements: (1) CAPTURE THE GENETTE ANALOGY IN FULL as the volume's reflexive frame — book pp.183-184, fulltext lines 6393-6415. Specifically: extract (a) the Genette/Proust/Narrative Discourse (1980) anchor; (b) the Narrative Discourse Revisited (1988) model-revision move; (c) the explicit disclaimer that this volume does not immediately necessitate revision (line 6403-6404); (d) the structuralism-challenged-by-poststructuralism passage (lines 6411-6415); (e) the 'structural models... elaborated upon, refined, eventually revised' arc (lines 6418-6420); (f) the 'first considered step' self-positioning (lines 6426-6427). Treat the Genette analogy as a multi-edge cluster (≥4 edges) NOT a single edge. (2) DOCUMENT THE FUTURE-RESEARCH AGENDA: (a) 'phenomenology... that bear further scrutiny' (line 6345-6346); (b) 'decouple the notion of play from the media objects we currently call games' (lines 6391-6392); (c) 'more evolved and sensitive modeling' as horizon (line 6428); (d) the cultural-historical arc of imagined-world transmission as future-trajectory anchor (lines 6445-6453). Each as a distinct future-research edge. (3) BACKWARD-RECAP edges to IG-02 (here/there dichotomy critique), IG-03 (PIM as 'the model'), IG-10 (incorporation as the synthesis) — these can be lighter, single-edge each. (4) NOTE THE CONCLUSION'S RHETORICAL REGISTER: opens with second-person experiential vignette (mirroring Intro's autobiographical opening) and closes with cultural-historical peroration — Calleja's rhetorical bookending is itself a meta-textual signal worth capturing as a single META node. (5) DO NOT enumerate the four conceptual challenges from IG-02 here — they are not re-stated in the Conclusion, only their displacement-by-incorporation is. (6) The Conclusion contains NO figures, NO games-by-name, NO theorists-by-name except Genette — keep the concept inventory tightly focused on the methodological-reflection and future-research moves.
notes: Conclusion is a 6-page lighter unit. Three internal sections confirmed: unnamed opening (pp.181-182), 'Implications' (pp.182-184), 'Imagining Worlds into Being' (pp.184-185); p.186 blank. The chapter's LOAD-BEARING THEORETICAL MOVE is the Genette analogy (pp.183-184) — structural-modelling-as-formalism with poststructuralism as the canonical successor trajectory; PIM positioned as 'a first considered step' inviting refinement, revision, and eventual outgrowth. This reflexive frame is THE VOLUME'S SELF-LOCATION on the structuralism-poststructuralism axis and licenses the dissertation's adaptation-and-extension trajectory directly. Genette is the SOLE NAMED INTERLOCUTOR in the chapter (single-theorist citation is striking; the rest of the chapter is conceptual peroration). Future-research themes consolidated: (i) further phenomenological scrutiny of incorporation; (ii) refinement / revision / eventual poststructural successor model; (iii) decoupling play from media-objects-currently-called-games; (iv) continuing cultural-historical arc of imagined-world transmission (digital → networked → next). Sparse on game loci (ZERO games-by-name) and on exegetical anchors for dissertation augmentation layers (NONE — all three layers remain anticipatory; the Genette anchor is within-discipline literary-theory, not a cross-layer bridge). Phase 0 manifest's three-heading structure CONFIRMED with no surprises.
